reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the BRCA1/BRCA2 germline interpretation use-case batch for use-case-brca1-brca2-germline-interpretation: 862 records (558 results, 182 evaluations, 92 configurations, 16 methods, 4 protocols, 4 claims, 3 datasets, 3 sources). All three pinned artifacts were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256; archived copies decompress to the same bytes. All 558 results were re-read with the reviewer's own parsers (the extractor's scripts were not run) and match. Cubuk et al. likelihood ratios and intervals were recomputed from the Supplementary Table 6 counts and Ramadane-Morchadi et al. predictive values from the printed sensitivity and specificity. No number changed. Details are in docs/reviews/use-cases/brca1-brca2-germline-interpretation-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any tool.
Cubuk Supplementary Tables 1, 8, 10, 11 and 13 and Ramadane-Morchadi Tables S1 to S6 and Table 3 were not checked; method types were not checked against Cubuk Supplementary Table 1.
The functional data behind the ENIGMA VCEP BayesDel calibration are not named in the stored records, so their overlap with the Findlay et al. 2018 data is unresolved.

SHACL shapes and npm run build were not run; npm test and npm run typecheck passed, and a scratch dry run adding the somatic oncogenicity, protein stability and this batch passed, with all four new and all ten existing judgements active.

errors.message: Cubuk et al. likelihood ratios that divide by a zero count in Supplementary Table 6 (30 benignity ratios with FN = 0, one positive ratio with TP = FP = 0); the printed value rests only on a zero-cell correction the Table 9 note says was not applied. Not shown as evidence.
Probably misprinted interval (92.3-97.5) removed from structured uncertainty; missing_metadata.uncertainty conflicting.
Metric qualifiers named each tool's threshold, which prevented any comparison; thresholds moved to score_category.

Limitations and notes rewritten from the sources: shared saturation genome editing data, Cubuk BayesDel thresholds are not the VCEP's, Align-GVGD trained on BRCA1/2, VEST3 under a 'VEST4' family record, thresholds tuned on the evaluated variants, Ambry employees. Two collector statements not supported by the sources were removed.
Scope notes added: benignity ratio is the reciprocal of the conventional negative likelihood ratio; log2 LR direction depends on the interval.
